turns.text: how to get my rating

To see your UTR rating, log in to your UTR Sports account on the website or app — your rating appears on your player profile. You'll see your overall rating, along with your match history and performance stats.

If you're looking for a **personalized explanation** of how your rating was calculated, what's driving it, or why it changed after a match, that's where **Rally** comes in. Rally is UTR's AI rating assistant, available free to all logged-in users.

**How to access Rally:**
1. Log in to UTR Sports
2. Tap the Search bar at the top
3. Open the "Chat with Rally" widget

Rally will give you detailed insights into your rating, match analysis, and personalized recommendations — it's the best way to understand your specific rating.

Is there something specific about your rating you'd like help with?
i dont have a rating how to get one

To get your first UTR rating, you need to play and record match results. Here's how it works:

**Getting your initial rating:**
- Play a match and have the result entered into UTR Sports (either through a UTR-hosted event, an imported result from an outside source like USTA or ITF, or a self-reported match)
- Just **one match result** is enough to receive a projected UTR rating
- After approximately **five matches**, your rating becomes fully reliable and stable

**Where results come from:**
- **UTR-hosted events** — register for a tournament on UTR Sports and your results post automatically
- **Imported results** — scores [location]ITF, Tennis Australia, high school, college, or other sanctioned sources sync into your profile
- **Self-reported matches** — you can log matches manually (though these don't count toward a Verified rating)

Once you have at least one match result in the system, your rating will appear on your profile. The more matches you play, the more accurate it becomes.

Are you looking to play in a UTR event, or do you have match results from another source that should be on your profile?
i cant play matchis beacuse i still have green dot classes

I understand — you're still in classes and can't play matches right now. That makes sense!

Your UTR rating will be ready whenever you're able to play. Once you finish your classes and start playing matches, just one result will give you your initial rating, and it'll build from there.

In the meantime, if you have any other questions about UTR or want to explore events for when you're free, here help. Is there anything else I can assist with?
what age do you have to be to play a macth

The Knowledge Base doesn't specify a minimum age requirement for players to participate in matches or events. Age eligibility can vary depending on the specific event or tournament.

I'd recommend checking the details of the event you're interested in, or reaching out to the event organizer directly — they can tell you if there are any age restrictions.

Is there a specific event you're looking at, or do you have other questions about getting started with UTR?
thats perfect beacuse my first tournament is in the start of september

That's great! Your first tournament in early September is perfect timing to get your initial rating. Once you play that match, you'll have your first UTR rating, and it'll build from there as you play more.

A couple of quick tips:
- Make sure your UTR Sports profile is set up and ready before the tournament
- After your matches, the results should post to your profile automatically (depending on how the tournament reports scores)
- Once you have a few matches under your belt, your rating will become more reliable

Good luck with your tournament! Feel free to reach out if you have any questions before or after. 🎾
after the tournament how will i get my rating

After your tournament, here's what happens:

**Your rating will post automatically** — the tournament organizer will enter the match results into UTR Sports, and your rating will appear on your profile. You don't need to do anything; it happens in the background.

**Timing:** Results typically post within a few days of the tournament ending, depending on how quickly the organizer uploads the scores.

**What to expect:**
- After your first match, you'll get a **projected rating**
- After about five matches total, your rating becomes fully reliable and stable
- Your rating will be visible on your UTR Sports player profile under your name and stats

Once your rating is live, you can log in anytime to see it, track your progress, and use **Rally** (UTR's AI rating assistant) to get personalized insights into how your rating is calculated and what's driving it.

You're all set! Enjoy your tournament. 🎾

Based on what I found, UTR Sports doesn't currently offer a free trial for Power. However, you can start with a free UTR Sports account and upgrade to Power anytime.

Here's how to get started:

**On the web:**
1. Go to [UTRSports.net](https://www.utrsports.net) and click "Join" in the top right
2. Create your free account
3. You can upgrade to Power during signup or anytime later by clicking "Start Power" and choosing monthly or annual

You can also upgrade using this link: [Power Subscription](https://app.utrsports.net/power-perks?utm_source=stewart&utm_medium=chat&utm_campaign=power_perks&utm_content=stewart_power)

Here's what Power includes:

**Performance & Insights**
- Full Performance Stats with match-by-match history, trends, and consistency data
- Rally Chatbot — personalized insights about your rating, match history, and recommendations
- Activity Stats with detailed breakdowns across matches, sets, and games

**College & Recruiting (Annual Power only)**
- College Prospect Power — manage your recruiting journey in one place
- College Coach View — see which coaches have viewed your profile in the past 12 months
- College Research Tool — explore programs, rosters, and upcoming events
- 2-Decimal Rating Visibility — see exact skill levels (e.g., 7.43 instead of just 7)

**Rankings & Community**
- Local Leaderboards & Expanded Rankings — see where you rank against peers in your area and beyond

**Savings & Perks**
- Play Verified Events at no Verified Fee — unlimited event registration discounts
- Exclusive Partner Discounts — Tennis Channel Plus, Tennis Warehouse, Diadem, Fabletics, and more
- Global Privileges (Annual only) — hotel discounts, travel credits, airport lounge access, car rental discounts

**Plans:**
- Monthly or Annual options available
- Annual includes all the extra perks above
